'''Beam altimeters''' were flight components utilized by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] onboard the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]]. The beam altimeter was located in the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] port ordnance pod alongside a specialized [[Scope/Legends|sight]], [[Targeting sensor/Legends|targeting sensors]], and [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]].<ref name="SWS" />
